# Saint affamé — proposition visuelle v1

Illustration de fiction produite avec l’outil intégré image_gen. Anatomie et rassemblement proposés ; les gestes humains ne représentent pas une obéissance automatique.

[Image](saint-affame-v1.png)

## Prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a cinematic painterly photoreal fantasy bestiary illustration of a SAINT AFFAME, an original instinctive non-living creature of shared emotion in a medieval magical civilization. In a large worn stone refuge hall, a striking tall nonhuman creature stands at the center of a loose gathering of ordinary adult medieval inhabitants. Main creature has a supple upright organic trunk, several long graceful fan-arranged articulated arms and softly pleated translucent membranes stretched between some arms like folded living fabric. No human face, no angel wings, no halo, no religious iconography, no crown, no humanoid saint statue. Its small smooth asymmetrical sensory top and unmistakably alien anatomy make it a creature, solemn and morally neutral. It opens its arms slowly in a readable welcoming expansive gesture. Around it a modest group of weary adults in practical patched wool clothing imitate the gesture, open hands and matching body rhythms, expressions of relief, courage and tired concentration, not hypnotized blank faces. A couple of people remain at the edge near an open doorway carrying travel bundles, hesitant, providing quiet narrative tension. Show the full creature and much of its graceful fan anatomy clearly, dominant central focus, people lower and distributed around it without obscuring the body. Soft warm reflected daylight through high windows, natural light passing through thin ivory and muted rose membranes, tactile subtle organic folds, aged stone and wood, realistic medieval refuge supplies in background. Mood tragic tenderness, real communal comfort with ambiguous dependence. No glowing control strings, no mind-control beams, no threatening monster grin, no gore, no magical force field blocking the doorway. Beautiful complex anatomical design, high-end original fantasy illustration, landscape composition. No text, no captions, no watermark. Proposed visual interpretation.
